alerts.text: Projection model v2 (28 Nov): minutes × PIR per minute replaces the plain PIR average (better on both backtests). Teammate in/out splits, short rest and per-team home edges were tested and did not help, so they only appear as information on player cards (e.g. Fournier +3.0 min without Dorsey, Maledon +1.2 without Campazzo).

This morning's plan was built on an out-of-date squad (Nwora, Diop, Procida). Rebuilt tonight from your R15 screenshot: Kamenjas, Vezenkov, Ward, Hifi, Maledon, Abalde, Davidovac, Balcerowski, Carter, Wilbekin, coach Navarro, 108.3 and 0.0 bank.

New projection model from tonight: long-run level over 3+ seasons, opponent defence and a light head-to-head nudge, ¾ model and ¼ site. It beat the site's projections and simple averages in a backtest (PLAYBOOK, 'Projection model'). Player cards show the breakdown.
Per-game rule updated (user, 27 Nov): max 2 players per game, but 3 from a heavy favourite (75%+) is fine.

Kamenjas was left out of Bosnia's game in Iceland (26 Nov) with the knee knock from R14 (reports also mention an ankle twist). A week of rest may help, but check Baskonia's status before Thursday: every variation has a Kamenjas → Sanli swap ready in cancel_if.

Dorsey played 35' for Greece (17 pts, 26 Nov) but Bartzokas says there's 'no timeline' for his return to Olympiacos: it's a coach decision, not fitness. I treat it as a coin flip and trimmed Fournier (14.0) and Cory Joseph (9.0) a little (overrides.json).
FIBA window so far: Vezenkov 27 pts in Bulgaria's 87–84 win over Denmark (26 Nov, maybe one more game); Procida joins Italy for Serbia on 29 Nov; Hifi rested. The next runs re-check before Thursday.
